name: session.help
description: Describe the methods this session accepts and the methods its blocks provide.
validation_notes: The result has the same form as `help.all`, with an added `http` field. It describes only the methods the session answers itself, such as `session.view` and `session.new_split`, and the block methods of the creators that session can use.
Most clients call `help.all` instead, which describes every method the server provides.
